plugins.description: Thirteen specialists plus an orchestrator agent for implementing Contentful-based composable platforms â content modeling (Topics & Assemblies), React/Next.js wiring (preview vs. delivery, GraphQL, on-demand revalidation), space and environment architecture (aliases, deployment pipeline, cross-space refs), reproducible CMA migrations via CLI, GraphQL Content API patterns, signed webhooks, delivery + image optimization, editorial Workflows (steps, per-step permissions, edit/publish rules, actions including Slack/Teams/Task/email/AI Action, sequential vs. parallel multi-workflow patterns), App Framework custom UI extensions, Personalization (former Ninetailed), rich text rendering, localization, and the Contentful MCP / CLI workflows that drive agent-led delivery. The agent (contentful-agent) is the entry point â it diagnoses scope, picks the skills, and orders the work, distinguishing sequential lanes from parallel ones. Includes a live reference of the Slalom Demo 2.0 space's 44 content types and a curated map of the Contentful Marketplace.

plugins.name: algolia
plugins.description: Twelve specialists for implementing Algolia-powered search experiences in composable platforms â index design (records, attributes, replicas, virtual replicas), relevance tuning (ranking, custom ranking, synonyms, query rules, typo, A/B, NeuralSearch hybrid), React InstantSearch / Next.js Hooks, the Autocomplete UI library, direct search-client usage (RSC, edge, multi-index), indexing pipelines (Marketplace app vs. Ingestion vs. custom Vercel-Function indexer), API-key strategy and secured keys for multi-tenant filtering, the Recommend API (Related Items, FBT, Trending, Looking Similar), AI surface (Personalization, NeuralSearch, Query Categorization, Dynamic Re-Ranking), Insights events and A/B testing, the Contentful â Algolia integration we ship by default on Composable DXP engagements, and Algolia MCP / CLI workflows for agent-led delivery. One agent (algolia-agent) sequences them. Five slash commands (/algolia-bootstrap, /algolia-audit, /algolia-relevance-review, /algolia-reindex, /algolia-keys-rotate) cover the canonical engagement lifecycle. Pairs tightly with the contentful plugin.
